quote_mismatches.quote:
When hypervelocity stars were first discovered in 2005
(Brown et al. 2005), dynamical ejection from the supermassive
black hole at the GC (Hills 1988) was supposed to be their only
origin because these stars move so fast that they are unbound
to the Galaxy. This scenario was challenged by the discovery of the
third hypervelocity star HE 0437-5439 (Edelmann et al. 2005), a
massive B star

Finally, the enigmatic hypervelocity star HE 0437-5439 is
re-investigated by inspecting its trajectory in the context of the
updated potentials.
